chunks: Tell: Bring your witnesses who testify that God has forbidden this. If they testify, do not testify with them; and do not follow the desires of those who denied Our signs and who do not believe in the Hereafter, and they equate their Lord.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Bring your witnesses' in Surah Al-An'am?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *tawhid* in legislation, asserting that divine prohibition (*haram*) is exclusive to God, thereby refuting the polytheists' claim that their idols or customs held legislative authority. It serves as a critical epistemological boundary, instructing the Prophet to reject human whims (*ahwa'*) and false testimony when they contradict clear divine signs, emphasizing that true justice (*'adl*) belongs solely to Allah.
